summary: Iteration 6 regression-tested the onboarding back-button bug fix (module-level lastOnboardingScreen in /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx). RUN 1 (17/17 PASS, 375x667 mobile viewport, public preview URL): fresh entry starts at step 1 splash; splash tap -> Welcome step 2; walked referral-skip -> 1/20..7/20 (name filled, gender screen renders Female/Male/Non-binary/Prefer not to say with 7/20 indicator); in-app back arrow steps one screen back (7/20 -> 6/20) and forward works (back to 7/20); 8x back returns to Welcome step 2. CORE REGRESSION D3 PASS: Welcome step 2 -> 'Log in' -> /login ('Welcome Back') -> browser back -> /onboarding resumes the SAME step (Welcome 'Create the life you desire' visible, splash 'tap anywhere to begin' NOT visible) - the reported bug is FIXED. E1 PASS: fresh reload starts at step 1 splash. RUN 2 (F1-F5 PASS): full 20-question completion walk (name, goals, selfDesc filled; Female + specificPerson=No selected; rest skipped) -> 'Generate My Profile' -> Generating screen -> auto-navigated to /subscription; @hera_user persisted correctly ({name:Maya, goals:[...], onboardingComplete:true}) and hera_onboarded=true (my raw localStorage assert saw JSON-quoted values because the async-storage shim encodes - test artifact, not an app bug). RESET VERIFICATION: persistAndNavigate (onboarding.tsx:684-696) provably executed (its AsyncStorage writes were observed), and lastOnboardingScreen=1 reset at line 686 runs unconditionally before those writes in the same function; combined with E1 (fresh entry = splash) the reset-on-completion requirement is satisfied. Mid-step resume could not be driven via UI because the only onboarding->login link exists on Welcome step 2, but the setScreen wrapper (lines 553-559) updates lastOnboardingScreen on EVERY step change, so the proven step-2 resume generalizes to all steps.

issues: Login screen has NO in-app back button and _layout.tsx sets gestureEnabled:false + headerBackVisible:false for /login - on iOS native a user tapping 'Log in' from onboarding Welcome has no way back (dead end). Only Android hardware back and browser back (web) work. Consider adding a visible back/close affordance or re-enabling the swipe gesture.

Only the step NUMBER survives a /login detour; entered answers (name, goals, etc.) are useState and are wiped on remount. A user who answers questions, backs to Welcome, visits login and returns must re-enter answers. Acceptable tradeoff but worth noting.

Edge case (not UI-testable without backend): login 'Account Not Found' -> router.replace('/onboarding') will RESUME the last onboarding step (module var) instead of restarting at step 1 - verify this matches product intent.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated.' Reference: ported Hera components incl. onboarding.tsx spl.heraTitle textShadow*.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires on splash (onboarding.tsx:376 uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop).
Splash/generating animations fall back to JS driver on web; benign but spammy - gate with Platform.OS !== 'web'.
Metro warning 'Require cycle: services/iapService.web.ts -> services/iapService.web.ts' still logged on app boot.
'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' - should be gated by Platform.OS !== 'web'.

action_items: Optional UX: add a back/close control on /login (or re-enable gestureEnabled) - currently a dead-end on iOS native.

Optional: decide whether login 'Account Not Found' -> /onboarding should resume the last step (current behavior) or restart at step 1; if restart, reset lastOnboardingScreen before that router.replace.

Optional hygiene: onboarding.tsx is 1153 lines (>700 guideline) - consider splitting screens into components; add testID attributes to back arrows/buttons/inputs for future automation (back arrow currently only reachable via coordinates).

Carryover: clean up RN-on-web deprecation warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver, iapService.web.ts require cycle, expo-notifications web listener) at main agent's discretion.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx:537 module-level `let lastOnboardingScreen = 1`, :551 useState(lastOnboardingScreen), :553-559 setScreen wrapper persists every step change, :686 persistAndNavigate resets to 1 before AsyncStorage writes - the fix is correct and minimal; reset line provably executed because the storage writes later in the same function were observed at runtime.

login.tsx contains no back control and _layout.tsx:38 disables the iOS back gesture for /login - see design_issues; the user's reported 'back button' only exists on Android (hardware) and web (browser).

subscription.tsx renders an unauthenticated auth-gate ('Create Account or Sign In', ~line 582) instead of the paywall+Sign In footer when authUser is null - my planned in-session re-entry path via that footer link does not exist in that state.
No testID attributes on any onboarding/login interactive elements - back arrows are Pressables with icon-only content, forcing coordinate-based taps in automation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding regression is fixed: /onboarding -> Welcome 'Log in' -> /login -> browser back resumes the same step (module-level lastOnboardingScreen). In-app back arrow is icon-only (no testID); tap coordinates (42,30) at 375x667 works. Skip links are get_by_text('Skip', exact=True); contacts screen 13/20 uses the main gradient button labelled 'Skip'. Full completion: fill name (3/20), goals (9/20), selfDesc (16/20), pick an option + YesNo on 23, then 'Generate My Profile' -> ~9s generating -> auto router.replace('/subscription'). When unauthenticated, /subscription shows an auth-gate ('Create Account or Sign In' / 'Continue with Email'), not the paywall footer. AsyncStorage web shim JSON-encodes values, so raw localStorage.getItem returns quoted strings - assert via the shim or strip quotes.
rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG: onboarding step was component-local useState initialized to 1, so unmount/remount of /onboarding (e.g. push /login then back) restarted at the splash. FIX (verified working): module-level lastOnboardingScreen persists the step across remounts; setScreen wrapper keeps it in sync on every transition; persistAndNavigate resets it to 1 on completion so the next fresh onboarding starts at the splash. Verified behaviors: step-2 resume after login+back (D3), in-app one-step back/forward (C1-C3), fresh entry at step 1 (A1, E1), completion navigates to /subscription with correct persisted user record (F1-F5).
